title: Getting started with Video Studio
brief: Generate a quick video tutorial about this public repo (theunisdk/video-studio) and include it in the repo along with OpenClaw.

scenes.headline: Ask for a video. Get a finished MP4.
scenes.narration: This is Video Studio. You ask Claude for a video in one sentence, and you get back a finished, narrated MP4.

scenes.headline: Open the repo in Claude Code and say what you need.
scenes.narration: Open the repo in Claude Code and say what you need. A marketing video for a website. A tutorial for your app. Or an explainer from your docs.

scenes.headline: Claude reads your sources and takes real screenshots.
scenes.narration: Claude starts with research. It visits the website, takes screenshots and reads the pages. For an app, it clicks through in a read-only browser, so nothing gets changed.

scenes.headline: A short script, and a voice-over for every scene.
scenes.narration: Next, it writes a short script, and records a natural voice-over for each scene with ElevenLabs.

scenes.headline: Animated in code, timed to the spoken words.
scenes.narration: The scenes are built in code, with React and Three.js. Every animation is timed to the words, so things appear right as they're said.

scenes.headline: A storyboard first, then the checked MP4.
scenes.narration: You can review a storyboard first. Then it renders the video with captions, and checks the file before it hands it over.

scenes.headline: Your videos stay on your machine.
scenes.narration: Your videos stay private. They live in folders that git ignores, so only the examples are in the public repo.

scenes.headline: Clone, install, add your key, and ask.
scenes.narration: To get started, clone the repo, install it, and add your ElevenLabs key. Then just ask. This video was made exactly that way.
